svg.title: Four refined D4 variants for tailrocks
svg.desc: Four refinements of the two-block isometric logo: grounded, lifted, larger top cube, and high-contrast.
svg.text: Top cube sits flush on the slab. Solid. Planted. The most confident reading.
Cube hovers above the slab. Suggests motion. About to land. Deployment in progress.
Top cube ≈ same width as the slab. Two peers. Balance instead of hierarchy.
Same as R1 (grounded) but with sharper shading. Bolder graphic feel. Punchier at small sizes.
